description: This file defines the PersistableProductReview class which extends ProductReviewEntity and adds a customerId property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PersistableProductReview
classes.description: A class extending ProductReviewEntity to include a customerId, representing a review that can be persisted with customer information.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customerId associated with this product review.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customerId for this product review.
